name: sdl
description: Scaffold and review SDL artifacts (IEC 62443-4-1 aligned) per feature branch.

interface.shortDescription: Create and review IEC 62443-aligned SDL evidence.
interface.longDescription: Scaffold per-feature SDL evidence, threat-model security-relevant changes, and review implementation diffs against the recorded mitigations.
defaultPrompt: Initialize the SDL baseline for this repository.
Create the SDL cycle for this feature.
Review this diff and update its SDL evidence.
